# planetscale_postgres_ip_restrictions (Data Source)

PostgresIPRestrictions DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "planetscale_postgres_ip_restrictions" "my_postgresiprestrictions" {
  database     = "...my_database..."
  organization = "...my_organization..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database` (String) The name of the database
- `organization` (String) The name of the organization the database belongs to

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `actor` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--actor))
- `cidrs` (List of String) The IPv4 ranges allowed to connect, in CIDR notation.
- `description` (String) A description of the entry.
- `id` (String) The ID of the IP restriction entry
- `role` (String) The Postgres role the entry applies to. Empty when it applies to all roles.
- `schema` (String) The Postgres schema the entry applies to. Empty when it applies to all schemas.

<a id="nestedatt--data--actor"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.actor`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID of the actor
